name: Psalms
lede: The nineteenth book of the Bible, in full: the hundred and fifty psalms in their five books — the blessed man and the tree by the streams, the heavens declaring the glory of God, Jehovah my shepherd, the hart panting after the water brooks, the harps hung on the willows, the songs of ascents and the last great hallelujahs — every word in the words of the ASV.

books.name: Blessed Is the Man
books.blurb: Book I opens: the blessed man like a tree planted by the streams of water, and the wicked like the chaff; why do the nations rage — thou art my son; I laid me down and slept; in the morning will I order my prayer; every night make I my bed to swim; when I consider thy heavens, what is man?; the lurking lion and the net; and the words of Jehovah, pure words, as silver tried in a furnace.

books.name: The Heavens Declare
books.blurb: How long, O Jehovah?; the fool hath said in his heart, There is no God; who shall sojourn in thy tabernacle?; the lines are fallen unto me in pleasant places; hide me under the shadow of thy wings; Jehovah is my rock and my fortress — the cords of death, the earth that shook, the large place; the heavens declare the glory of God; some trust in chariots; and my God, my God, why hast thou forsaken me?
